title: Flip Finder sees through gil laundering even when it fills most recent sales
blurb: The Flip Finder's conservative estimate now throws out sales that can only be gil laundering before taking the middle of recent sales. A sale over a million gil for an item any NPC sells for a few hundred is ignored, as is a sale over a million gil that towers fifty times above the item's other recent sales. Previously, four laundering sales out of six could still put a nine-figure estimate on an item that really sells for 20,000 gil. The item page's flip comparison card uses the same rules.
